supersedes: Only the unsupported interpretation in checkpoint-0001.reason; checkpoint-0001 itself is preserved byte-for-byte.
finding: UTF-8 no-BOM records were read using Windows PowerShell default Get-Content decoding in the diagnostic command, which displayed UTF-8 en dash bytes as mojibake. A subsequent explicit strict UTF-8 decode confirms checkpoint-0001 contains the exact U+2013 user wording. Therefore the earlier claim that attempt.json and the precheck manifest were misencoded is not substantiated and is withdrawn.
